work.title: The Life of Timon of Athens
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 5, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. The woods. Timon's cave, and a rude tomb seen
scene.location: The woods. Timon's cave, and a rude tomb seen

content.text: Enter a Soldier in the woods, seeking Timon.

lines.text: By all description this should be the place.
lines.plainText: By all description this should be the place

lines.text: Who's here? Speak, ho! No answer? What is this?
lines.plainText: Who's here Speak ho No answer What is this

lines.text: Timon is dead, who hath outstretched his span.
lines.plainText: Timon is dead who hath outstretched his span

lines.text: Some beast read this; there does not live a man.
lines.plainText: Some beast read this there does not live a man

lines.text: Dead, sure, and this his grave. What's on this tomb
lines.plainText: Dead sure and this his grave What's on this tomb

lines.text: I cannot read. The character I'll take with wax.
lines.plainText: I cannot read The character I'll take with wax

lines.text: Our captain hath in every figure skill,
lines.plainText: Our captain hath in every figure skill

lines.text: An aged interpreter, though young in days.
lines.plainText: An aged interpreter though young in days

lines.text: Before proud Athens he's set down by this,
lines.plainText: Before proud Athens he's set down by this

lines.text: Whose fall the mark of his ambition is.
lines.plainText: Whose fall the mark of his ambition is
